description: pi-watcher dependency update grouping (TASK-0108): Pi SDK pair and TypeScript toolchain stay coherent; majors never batch.

packageRules.description: Pi SDK pair must always move together to one tested release (exact dev pins).
TypeScript toolchain moves as one coherent unit (tsc, lint parser, node types).
Vitest and coverage provider move together.
Everything else: separate PRs per major; minors may group per package.
